user.title: Notify Dashboard
user.description: Setting up notify.dashboard still requires a `notify:` YAML entry (see README) — this screen only configures the optional settings below.

data_description.mirror_dismiss_to: Lists notify entities and legacy notify services/groups. Only works for Companion App (mobile_app) targets — other notify integrations don't understand this and would just show a literal text message instead.

notification_not_dismissable.message: '{item_id}' can't be dismissed — this notification is persistent.

missing_mirror_target.title: Mirror target no longer exists
missing_mirror_target.description: The configured 'Also clear notifications on' target `{entity_id}` doesn't exist anymore (it may have been renamed or removed). Notifications dismissed on this dashboard won't be cleared from that target until you update it under Settings > Devices & Services > Notify Dashboard > Configure.
